name: Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited
summary: Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited engages in the designing, development, manufacturing, and sale of power generation equipment in China and internationally. It operates through five segments: Clean and Efficient Energy Equipment, Renewable Energy Sources Equipment, Engineering and Trade, Modern Manufacturing Services, and Emerging Growth Industries. The company also offers construction contracting and services. It produced power generation equipment with a total capacity of 24.883 million kilowatt; 7,093 MW hydro-generating unit; 14,964 MW steam turbine generators; 2,826 MW wind power units; 15,256 MW power station steam turbines; and 16,406 MW power station boilers. The company was formerly known as Dongfang Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited in October 2007. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Chengdu, the People's Republic of China. Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited is a subsidiary of Dongfang Electric Corporation.
